content.title: Cervecerias Unidas: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: SANTIAGO, Chile (AP) — Compania Cervecerias Unidas (CCU) on Wednesday reported a second-quarter loss of $11.8 million, after reporting a profit in the same period a year earlier. The Santiago, Chile-based company said it had a loss of 6 cents per share. The wine, spirits and soft drink company posted revenue of $612.2 million in the period.
